Christian McCaffrey.st: FULL TEAM WORK — BASE DURABILITY DISCOUNT ONLY
Christian McCaffrey.nm: McCaffrey returned to 11-on-11 team work and the prior practice absence was part of the planned workload cycle.
Christian McCaffrey.na: Remove any extra camp-only penalty. Retain the existing age/workload/durability discount.

Ashton Jeanty.nm: The injury is now believed to be a sprained right ankle rather than a major knee injury. It is not considered long-term, but the exact grade and return timetable remain unknown.
Ashton Jeanty.na: Reduce short-term availability and do not pay above the current fair price until the return timetable is clearer. No major season-long projection cut without evidence of a high-grade sprain.
Ashton Jeanty.current_recommendation: HOLD / FAIR — ankle sprain is not considered long-term, but do not reach until the timetable is clearer

DeVonta Smith.nm: Smith returned to full practice after the hamstring absence.
DeVonta Smith.na: Remove the temporary limited-practice penalty; retain only normal soft-tissue recurrence awareness.

TreVeyon Henderson.nm: Henderson slipped while cutting during 11-on-11 work, had his right foot/ankle examined and did not return. The field was notably slick and there is not yet a diagnosis.
TreVeyon Henderson.na: Apply a small temporary availability discount only. Do not make a major rank or season-projection cut unless follow-up practice or imaging shows a multi-week injury.

Makai Lemon.nm: Lemon returned to full practice and participated in team drills with the starting offense. This clears the first major recovery benchmark after the recurring hamstring issue.
Makai Lemon.na: Partially restore availability, but retain a recurrence and rookie role-readiness discount until full work is sustained across consecutive practices.

George Kittle.st: ACHILLES RECOVERY — OFF PUP / INDIVIDUAL WORK
George Kittle.nm: Kittle was activated from Active/PUP and returned to practice in individual work, improving the chance he avoids an automatic four-game absence.
George Kittle.na: Increase Week 1 availability probability, but retain the post-Achilles explosiveness, YAC and workload discount until team work is sustained.

Jonathon Brooks.nm: Hubbard's Week 1 readiness and the announced timeshare remove the prior Brooks-heavy median assumption.
Jonathon Brooks.na: Re-center to a 1A/1B committee while retaining a takeover ceiling and knee/availability risk.

Chuba Hubbard.nm: Expected Week 1 readiness plus Carolina's announced timeshare makes the prior injury-window workload too low.
Chuba Hubbard.na: Raise the full-season median to the 1A/1B committee baseline; Brooks still caps workhorse ceiling.

Mike Washington Jr..nm: Jeanty is believed to have an ankle sprain that is not considered long-term. Washington remains the contingency back with short-term lead-role upside if Jeanty misses early games.
Mike Washington Jr..na: Keep the late-round contingency premium, but do not price in a long Jeanty absence.

Kaytron Allen.nm: Preseason usage and current depth context support a tertiary/short-yardage base role rather than the prior 350-380 rushing-yard median.
Kaytron Allen.na: Lower standalone projection; retain contingent touchdown/short-yardage ceiling only if injuries open the room.

Kaleb Johnson.nm: Green Bay traded for Johnson after Jacobs moved to the Commissioner’s Exempt List. The move creates a real near-term rotation and power-role opportunity, but Lloyd retains first claim on lead work.
Kaleb Johnson.na: Raise the median modestly from onboarding while keeping Johnson behind Lloyd until regular-season snaps, routes, carries and goal-line work prove otherwise.
Kaleb Johnson.current_recommendation: FAIR / LATE CONTINGENCY ADD — role improved, but Lloyd remains ahead entering Week 1

Corey Kiner.st: TRADED TO NEW ENGLAND / RB3 CONTINGENCY ROLE
Corey Kiner.ns: 2026-08-30 NEW ENGLAND TRADE / REGULAR-SEASON UNIVERSE ADD
Corey Kiner.nm: New England acquired Kiner from Arizona for a 2028 seventh-round pick and kept him as the third running back behind Stevenson and Henderson. The trade plus final-roster decision creates a real contingent path to touches.
Corey Kiner.na: Admit as a deep contingency back. Do not project standalone weekly value while Stevenson and Henderson remain healthy; upgrade only if regular-season usage or an availability event creates a larger role.
Corey Kiner.current_recommendation: FAIR / DEEP CONTINGENCY ADD — no standalone draft priority while Stevenson and Henderson are healthy

Tank Dell.st: IR — DESIGNATED TO RETURN / WEEK 5 EARLIEST
Tank Dell.nm: Houston placed Dell on injured reserve with a designation to return. He must miss at least four games but is expected to have a 2026 return path, making him materially fantasy-relevant despite severe availability uncertainty.
Tank Dell.na: Admit as an IR/late-season ceiling stash. Do not assume immediate full-time usage when eligible; upgrade only when practice participation and game usage establish his route share and explosiveness.
Tank Dell.current_recommendation: FAIR / IR STASH — contingent late-season ceiling, no early active-roster priority

Jonnu Smith.st: SIGNED BY GREEN BAY / MUSGRAVE PUP OPPORTUNITY
Jonnu Smith.ns: 2026-08-31 GREEN BAY SIGNING / REGULAR-SEASON UNIVERSE ADD
Jonnu Smith.nm: Green Bay signed Jonnu Smith after his 2025 season in Pittsburgh. Luke Musgrave is on reserve/PUP, creating a real early-season path to TE2/H-back snaps behind Tucker Kraft.
Jonnu Smith.na: Admit as a late/waiver contingent tight end. Do not reduce Tucker Kraft solely because Smith was added; upgrade Smith only if routes, targets or red-zone usage show a material receiving role.
Jonnu Smith.current_recommendation: FAIR / LATE TE CONTINGENCY — monitor routes and red-zone work; Kraft remains primary
